approval_scope: Create this isolated private pilot repository using existing credential custody
Push independently authored synthetic workflow fixtures and test branches
Apply and remove the attached ruleset only on this pilot repository
Perform bounded positive and negative branch behavior tests; no production target changes

expected_behavior_tests.operation: Direct fast-forward write to protected branch
Merge pull request with failing ges-pilot check
Merge pull request with successful ges-pilot check
Read effective policy and actor bypass after apply
Remove pilot ruleset and verify ordinary branch write recovery

recovery: Retain pilot repository and captured policy preimage; remove only pilot-created ruleset by recorded ID; verify recovery. Repository deletion requires separate authorization.
capability_limits: Available native ruleset features, permissions and successful runner execution must be verified on the actual proposed target before activation; no capability is assumed from this plan.
